title: D-ID Named a Leader in AI Video Generators – G2 Fall 2026
summary: D-ID earned the Leader badge in G2's AI Video Generators category, Fall 2026 Report, based on verified user reviews. Read more.
body_markdown:
*D-ID has been named a Leader in the AI Video Generators category in G2’s Fall 2026 Report, based on verified reviews from real users on the G2 platform.*


The recognition adds to a G2 standing D-ID has built over several report cycles, and it reflects how teams are actually using the platform: to produce training, onboarding, internal communications, and customer-facing video without a camera, a studio, or a production crew.


## D-ID Earned the Leader Badge in the AI Video Generators Category on G2


D-ID has earned the **Leader badge in G2’s AI Video Generators category** for the Fall 2026 Report.


G2 badges are not awarded by G2 staff. They come out of verified user reviews, combined with G2’s scoring of two things: customer satisfaction, drawn from review ratings across categories like ease of use, quality of support, and likelihood to recommend, and market presence, which weighs factors like company size, reviewer volume, and market share. A product only lands in the Leader quadrant when both scores clear a threshold relative to the rest of the category. That is what separates a Leader badge from a marketing claim: it is a snapshot of what paying customers report back to G2, not a claim D-ID makes about itself.


This builds on D-ID’s existing G2 presence, including its[4.6/5 average rating from verified users](https://www.d-id.com/blog/d-id-g2/) , and follows Leader recognitions D-ID has picked up in prior report cycles. See D-ID’s live[G2 profile](https://www.g2.com/products/d-id/reviews) for the current review count and category breakdown.


## Why This Recognition Matters for Teams Using AI Video


A G2 badge is a lagging indicator: it reflects what current customers already experience day to day. Three things come up repeatedly in D-ID’s G2 reviews:


- **Faster production, with no camera or studio required.** Teams generate finished video from a script or existing content, cutting out the shoot day, the crew and the edit-review cycle a traditional production needs.
- **Consistent training and onboarding content.** Because the video comes from a script and an avatar rather than a one-off recording, a course or onboarding series keeps the same presenter and tone across every module, in every language it ships in.
- **Easy updates when messaging changes.** A policy update, a pricing change or a corrected line is a script edit and a re-render, not a new shoot.


D-ID’s two core products sit behind these results: AI video creation with realistic digital avatars for scripted, presenter-led video, and[AI Avatar Agents](https://www.d-id.com/ai-agents/) for real-time, conversational avatar experiences that respond dynamically and can be connected to a team’s own knowledge.


Reviewers describe the practical effect directly:


> “The intuitive interface of D-ID allows even those without video editing experience to create professional content, expanding access to video production.”
>
>
> – Edyta L., Mid-Market


> “I use several agents on my websites; it eliminates FAQs and gives the client visiting a more personal treatment – clients like that.”
>
>
> – Hermann P., Co-Founder & CIO, Small Business


For teams evaluating an AI video generator tool, a G2 Leader badge is one input among several, but it comes from people already running the platform in production, which is a different kind of evidence than a features page.
